name: @darkhorseone/mcp-server-uk-parliament-interests

tools.name: ukpi_categories_list
tools.description: Return a list of categories interests should be registered under, sorted by category number.

Skip.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

Take.description: The number of records to return, default is 20.

tools.name: ukpi_categories_get_by_id
tools.description: Return details of an interest category by ID.

tools.name: ukpi_interests_list
tools.description: Return a list of interests that have been published on a register.

MemberId.description: Search for an interest created by member with this ID.

CategoryId.description: Search for an interest within a specific category with this ID.

PublishedFrom.description: Search for an interest published on or after this date.

PublishedTo.description: Search for an interest published on or before this date.

RegisteredFrom.description: Search for an interest registered on or after this date.

RegisteredTo.description: Search for an interest registered on or before this date.

UpdatedFrom.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or after this date.

UpdatedTo.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or before this date.

RegisterId.description: Search for an interest published in a register with this ID. If not provided, default value is latest register ID.

ExpandChildInterests.description: If true returns related interests in a nested format, rather than as individual items.

Take.description: The number of records to return, default is 20. Maximum is 20.

SortOrder.description: The order in which to return records.

Skip.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

tools.name: ukpi_interests_csv
tools.description: Return interests that have been published on a register as a collection of CSVs packaged in a ZIP file.

MemberId.description: Search for an interest created by member with this ID.

CategoryId.description: Search for an interest with associated category with this ID.

PublishedFrom.description: Search for an interest published on or after this date.

PublishedTo.description: Search for an interest published on or before this date.

RegisteredFrom.description: Search for an interest registered on or after this date.

RegisteredTo.description: Search for an interest registered on or before this date.

UpdatedFrom.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or after this date.

UpdatedTo.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or before this date.

RegisterId.description: Search for an interest published in a register with this ID. If not provided, default value is latest register ID.

IncludeFieldDescriptions.description: Returns a metadata file for each category, containing a list of fields which are available for a member to add further information about the interest.

tools.name: ukpi_interests_get_by_id
tools.description: Return the latest version of an interest which has been published.

tools.name: ukpi_registers_list
tools.description: Return a list of published versions of registers of interests.

SessionId.description: Search for registers published within a parliamentary session with this ID. Find session data at https://whatson-api.parliament.uk/.

Skip.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

Take.description: The number of records to return, default is 20.

tools.name: ukpi_registers_get_by_id
tools.description: Return a published version of a register of interests by ID.

tools.name: ukpi_registers_document
tools.description: Return a published register as a PDF document by ID.

type.description: Whether to return a document containing the full register or only updates. Default value is Full.
